name: Asia East Official #1
lore: Dedicated low-latency competitive server hosted in Tokyo for standard 5v5 ranked matches.

name: Guild War Coliseum A
lore: Official faction warfare battleground where rival syndicates clash for territory control banners.

name: Casual Sandbox & Hangout
lore: Peaceful non-pvp lobby with infinite respawns and interactive emote mini-games for casual chatter.

name: Infernal Dragon Raid
lore: Mythic tier 12-player raid chamber facing the Molten Drake Ignis. Full room waiting on tank.

name: Underground Deathmatch
lore: Fast-paced free-for-all bloodbath with instant power-up weapon drops every 30 seconds.

name: Frozen Citadel Siege
lore: Tactical breach and defend mode over a snowbound fortress gate with battering ram mechanics.

name: Speedrun Cooperative Hub
lore: Duo and quad dungeon time-trial room competing for the weekly global leaderboard crowns.

name: Pirate Cove Escort
lore: Payload escort mission along treacherous tropical coastal boardwalks with cannon fire hazards.

name: Cyber District Hide & Seek
lore: Neon-drenched alleyways where hunters use sonar pulses to track shape-shifting prop fugitives.

name: Championship Grand Final
lore: Spectated tournament broadcast lobby featuring locked custom loadouts and referee oversight.
